functions.name: duckbot_system_status
functions.description: Get comprehensive DuckBot system status and health information

implementation.code:
import psutil
import subprocess
import json
import os
from datetime import datetime

def execute():
    """Get system status information"""
    try:
        status_report = '🚀 **DuckBot System Status**\n\n'
        
        # System Information
        cpu_percent = psutil.cpu_percent(interval=1)
        memory = psutil.virtual_memory()
        disk = psutil.disk_usage('/')
        
        status_report += '💻 **System Resources:**\n'
        status_report += f'• CPU Usage: {cpu_percent:.1f}%\n'
        status_report += f'• Memory Usage: {memory.percent:.1f}% ({memory.used // (1024**3)}GB / {memory.total // (1024**3)}GB)\n'
        status_report += f'• Disk Usage: {disk.percent:.1f}% ({disk.used // (1024**3)}GB / {disk.total // (1024**3)}GB)\n\n'
        
        # Check for DuckBot processes
        try:
            result = subprocess.run(['tasklist', '/FI', 'IMAGENAME eq python.exe', '/FO', 'CSV'], 
                                  capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
            python_processes = result.stdout.count('"python.exe"')
            
            if python_processes > 0:
                status_report += f'🐍 **Python Processes:** {python_processes} running\n\n'
            
            # Check for specific DuckBot services
            services_to_check = [
                ('8787', 'DuckBot WebUI'),
                ('11434', 'Ollama'),
                ('3000', 'n8n'),
                ('8888', 'ComfyUI'),
                ('6333', 'LM Studio')
            ]
            
            status_report += '🔌 **Service Ports:**\n'
            for port, service in services_to_check:
                try:
                    result = subprocess.run(['netstat', '-ano', '|', 'findstr', f':{port}'], 
                                          shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
                    if result.returncode == 0 and result.stdout.strip():
                        status_report += f'✅ {service} (:{port}) - Running\n'
                    else:
                        status_report += f'❌ {service} (:{port}) - Not detected\n'
                except:
                    status_report += f'⚠️ {service} (:{port}) - Check failed\n'
            
        except Exception as e:
            status_report += f'⚠️ **Service Detection Error:** {str(e)}\n'
        
        # Check for DuckBot files and directories
        duckbot_dirs = [
            os.path.expanduser('~/Desktop/DuckBot-Consolidated-v4.2'),
            os.path.expanduser('~/Desktop/DuckBot-v3.1.0'),
            os.path.expanduser('~/Desktop/DuckBot')
        ]
        
        status_report += '\n📁 **DuckBot Installation:**\n'
        for duckbot_dir in duckbot_dirs:
            if os.path.exists(duckbot_dir):
                status_report += f'✅ Found: {duckbot_dir}\n'
                
                # Check key files
                key_files = ['START_ENHANCED_DUCKBOT.bat', 'requirements.txt', 'duckbot/']
                for file_name in key_files:
                    file_path = os.path.join(duckbot_dir, file_name)
                    if os.path.exists(file_path):
                        status_report += f'  • {file_name}\n'
        
        # Timestamp
        timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
        status_report += f'\n⏰ **Status Time:** {timestamp}\n'
        
        return status_report
        
    except Exception as e:
        return f'❌ Error getting system status: {str(e)}'

implementation.code:
import os
from pathlib import Path

def execute(info_type: str = 'overview'):
    """Get DuckBot project information"""
    try:
        # Find DuckBot directory
        possible_dirs = [
            Path('~/Desktop/DuckBot-Consolidated-v4.2').expanduser(),
            Path('~/Desktop/DuckBot-v3.1.0').expanduser(),
            Path('~/Desktop/DuckBot').expanduser()
        ]
        
        duckbot_dir = None
        for dir_path in possible_dirs:
            if dir_path.exists():
                duckbot_dir = dir_path
                break
        
        if not duckbot_dir:
            return '❌ DuckBot directory not found'
        
        if info_type == 'overview':
            return '''🦆 **DuckBot v4.2 - Complete AI Operating System**

**Overview:**
DuckBot is a comprehensive AI-powered operating system featuring multiple integrations including AI routing, service management, cost tracking, and various AI ecosystem connections.

**Key Components:**
• AI Router System - Intelligent model selection and routing
• Service Management - Control various AI services and tools
• Cost Tracking - Monitor AI usage and costs
• Web Interface - Modern web-based dashboard
• Multiple AI Integrations - Support for various AI providers

**Architecture:**
• Modular design with pluggable components
• Real-time monitoring and health checks
• Cross-platform compatibility (Windows, Linux, macOS)
• RESTful API for external integrations

**Version:** 4.2 (Consolidated)
**Status:** Active Development'''
        
        elif info_type == 'features':
            return '''🌟 **DuckBot Features**

**AI Capabilities:**
• Multi-model AI routing with intelligent selection
• Support for OpenAI, Anthropic, local models via LM Studio
• Real-time AI task processing and monitoring
• Cost tracking and usage analytics
• Conversation memory and context management

**Service Management:**
• Start/stop monitoring for various AI services
• Integration with ComfyUI, n8n, Jupyter, LM Studio
• Health monitoring and automatic recovery
• Port management and conflict resolution

**User Interface:**
• Modern web-based dashboard
• Real-time system monitoring
• Interactive chat interface
• Cost visualization and analytics
• Service status indicators

**Integration Features:**
• OpenWebUI tool integration
• Discord bot with slash commands
• VibeVoice TTS capabilities
• LiveKit WebRTC support
• RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation)

**Development Tools:**
• Code analysis and debugging
• Project workflow management
• Automated testing and validation
• Documentation generation'''
        
        elif info_type == 'integrations':
            # List available integrations
            duckbot_module_dir = duckbot_dir / 'duckbot'
            if duckbot_module_dir.exists():
                integrations = []
                for file in duckbot_module_dir.glob('*_integration.py'):
                    integrations.append(file.stem.replace('_integration', '').title())
                
                integration_list = '''🔗 **Available Integrations:**\n\n'''
                for integration in sorted(integrations):
                    integration_list += f'• {integration}\n'
                
                # Add known major integrations
                major_integrations = [
                    'ByteBot (Desktop Automation)',
                    'Archon (Multi-Agent System)', 
                    'Charm Ecosystem (Terminal UI)',
                    'ChromiumOS Integration',
                    'WSL (Windows Subsystem for Linux)',
                    'VibeVoice (Text-to-Speech)',
                    'LiveKit (WebRTC)',
                    'Discord Bot',
                    'MetaGPT (AI Collaboration)',
                    'Cost Management System',
                    'WebUI Manager'
                ]
                
                integration_list += '\n**Major Integration Systems:**\n\n'
                for integration in major_integrations:
                    integration_list += f'🚀 {integration}\n'
                
                return integration_list
            else:
                return '❌ DuckBot modules directory not found'
        
        elif info_type == 'setup':
            return '''⚙️ **DuckBot Setup Information**

**Quick Start:**
1. Navigate to DuckBot directory
2. Run START_ENHANCED_DUCKBOT.bat
3. Choose your preferred startup mode
4. Access the web interface at localhost:8787

**Requirements:**
• Windows 10/11 (recommended) or Linux/macOS
• Python 3.8+ (3.10+ recommended)
• 8GB+ RAM minimum (16GB+ recommended)
• 2GB+ free disk space

**Optional Components:**
• Go 1.20+ (for Charm ecosystem tools)
• Node.js 16+ (for React components)
• Docker (for containerized services)
• NVIDIA GPU (for AI acceleration)

**Startup Modes Available:**
• Ultimate Complete Mode - All integrations
• Enhanced WebUI - Modern web interface
• Charm Terminal - Beautiful command-line interface
• Service Management - Individual service control
• Development Mode - For testing and development

**Configuration:**
• Environment variables in .env file
• Settings in config/ directory
• Customizable through web interface
• API configuration through settings files'''
        
        else:
            return f'❌ Unknown info type: {info_type}'
            
    except Exception as e:
        return f'❌ Error getting project info: {str(e)}'
